# Transparency USA

> A comprehensive platform for tracking state-level campaign finance, political donations, and lobbying activities across the United States.

Transparency USA provides searchable databases of political money and spending at the state level, enabling citizens, researchers, and media to understand the flow of campaign contributions and lobbying expenditures. The platform offers data access through web tools, APIs, and embeddable widgets while supporting expansion to additional states.

## Key Topics

## Core Platform & Data Access

- [Home](https://www.transparencyusa.org): Homepage providing access to state political money data and transparency tools
- [Data Sales](https://www.transparencyusa.org/data-sales): API and data export services for campaign finance data in CSV/JSON formats
- [Our Data on Your Site](https://www.transparencyusa.org/our-data-on-your-site): Information on embedding Transparency USA widgets and data on partner sites
- [Claim Your Page](https://www.transparencyusa.org/claim-your-page): Tool for candidates to verify and customize their campaign finance pages
- [Add a State](https://www.transparencyusa.org/add-a-state): Information on sponsoring expansion of Transparency USA to new states

## Education & Reference

- [Common Campaign Finance Terms](https://www.transparencyusa.org/campaign-finance-terms): Glossary defining common campaign finance terminology and concepts
- [Lobbying: How It Works](https://www.transparencyusa.org/lobbying-how-it-works): Educational guide explaining lobbying processes and tracking in state politics
- [Videos](https://www.transparencyusa.org/videos): Video tutorials on using the campaign finance database and tools
- [Articles](https://www.transparencyusa.org/articles): Hub for articles and analysis on campaign finance and political money

## About & Support

- [About](https://www.transparencyusa.org/about-us): Organization mission, history, and information about Transparency USA
- [Our Team](https://www.transparencyusa.org/team): Staff directory and leadership information for Transparency USA nonprofit
- [Subscribe](https://www.transparencyusa.org/subscribe): Subscription and donation page for supporting the organization
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.transparencyusa.org/faq): Common questions about campaign finance data and platform usage
- [Submit a Support Ticket](https://support.transparencyusa.org/support/tickets/new): Support ticket submission form for technical and general inquiries
- [Media Inquiries](https://www.transparencyusa.org/media-inquiries): Contact information for media and press inquiries about political data
